prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE dialogue bust emotion variant for Terminus, based very closely on the supplied character concept. The concept is the authority for anatomy, apparent age, face geometry, hair, clothes, every accessory and design detail; do not redesign anything. Coreto style: monochrome sepia, black hand-inked outlines, dark brown crosshatching, fine stippling, light parchment highlights INSIDE the silhouette, no painted background. Keep the same stylization, relative line weights, upper-left lighting and palette as concept. ONE character only, portrait 3:4 canvas, head through waist/upper hips, complete head, ears and shoulders, hands fully within frame if shown. Leave clear transparent margins, reserve enough room for restrained gestures. Keep original facing direction and proportions. Do not add props, symbols, lettering, sweat drops, emotion icons, aura, scenery or floor shadow. Actual transparent background. Final export is 504x672; draw legibly at that scale.
CHARACTER: Mavren Chave-de-Cobre. INVARIANTS: Adult male goblin, dark short hair and WHITE eyebrows, miniature tool necklace, key belt, practical work vest and straps.
EMOTION: NEUTRO / NEUTRAL. Calm attentive resting face, relaxed mouth, no pronounced smile or scowl. Keep concept's original orientation, age, design and resting body pose, hands and held objects. PERSONALITY: Conciliatory negotiator; amiable satisfied smile, vulnerable sorrow, sober anger without appeasing smile, puzzled uncertainty.
Do not make existing hand-held objects disappear; change only facial tension into a neutral attentive expression. Preserve eye line and original crop, modest transparent margins.
inspecao_visual: Conferido lado a lado: identidade, figurino, acessórios, anatomia, leitura da emoção, enquadramento e transparência. Avaliação artística do autor pendente.

verificacao_tecnica.exportacao: Lanczos com alfa pré-multiplicado, escala proporcional, canvas transparente 504x672, alinhamento inferior, sRGB, PNG não entrelaçado.
